newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Low interest rates to support shares - CS Research.
newsitem.headline: Low interest rates to support shares - CS Research.

text.p: The recent rally in the Swiss bond market is not likely to continue, nevertheless a low risk of higher interest rates should support the share market, CS Research said in its latest market strategy report.
However, even though positive sentiment could linger in the short term, a sideways share market trading pattern is more likely when viewed on a three-month horizon, the report said.
On a 12-month perspective, the blue-chip SMI index could move to a level of between 3,900 to 4,100 points while 10-year government bond yields move to within a 4.0 to 4.5 percent range, it added.
The SMI is currently just at the 3,800 level and 10-year federal bond yields are around 3.9 percent.
